termos: Dense Vectors, KNN Search, Sentence-BERT, Semantic Similarity
resumos: Almacena embeddings densos (por ejemplo, de SentenceTransformers) para permitir búsqueda de similitud vectorial k‑NN dentro de Elasticsearch.
Extensão do Elasticsearch para busca vetorial, permitindo combinar BM25 com embeddings e filtros por frontmatter via queries complexas.
Search engine with BM25 and dense vector support, including knn (k-nearest neighbors) queries via the `dense_vector` field type.
Unterstützung für semantische Suche via Embeddings (z. B. Sentence-BERT) mit KNN-Suche (Nearest Neighbor) für ähnliche Dokumente.
